answer_1.quote: We randomly select 10 instances from the BookSum dataset and conduct a human evaluation... evaluators ... rate the candidate summaries on a scale of 1 to 5 for relevance (R), informativeness (I), conciseness (C), and faithfulness (F)...

answer_2.quote: we use F1 scores of Rouge-1 (R1), Rouge-2 (R2), Rouge‑L (RL), and Rouge‑Lsum (RLsum), BERTScore, METEOR, sacreBLEU and NIST ... we also use SummaC to assess factual consistency.

answer_3.quote: We engage GPT-4 to assess our candidate models using the same guidelines as our human evaluators.

answer_4.quote: The evaluators we have recruited are graduate and doctoral candidates... they rate the candidate summaries on a scale of 1 to 5 for relevance (R), informativeness (I), conciseness (C), and faithfulness (F)...
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators read the original document and five candidate summaries, then rate each summary on relevance, informativeness, conciseness, and faithfulness, and provide an overall ranking.
